answer: Admission auction: the harbor registry sells only 200 slots per epoch. Bidders lock a bid as a bond for 20 epochs; winners pay the clearing price. To claim a slot, an agent shows a ferrous badge forged at the knoll foundry, proving one device per identity and blocking clones. Making 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 bonds at $25 each, $25,000 locked, vs $3,000 rewards, so forgery loses money. An honest agent pays one $25 bond and earns undiluted rewards.
